scope: isolated Windows local Orca 1.4.209 terminal running the real SteerLine console against one native Task and SQLite

regression_before_fix.twelve_screen_reads: screen source retained the prior Attempt for more than 6 seconds after the new Attempt was committed
regression_before_fix.cause: the console copied its automatically followed Attempt into the persisted manual-history selection, pinning the old Attempt

after_fix.timestamp_bound: the Attempt created_at is assigned before its SQLite commit and the visible_at timestamp was taken after Orca returned the rendered terminal frame

conclusion: The local visible Orca terminal frame reflected this center step transition within 2 seconds after the committed Attempt. Manual historical Attempt selection remains pinned by design. This sample does not prove the separate home remote business-message-to-viewer latency or Windows desktop screenshot/UAC gate.
